title: Contiguous One Blocks
prompt:
Implement `label_one_blocks(bits)`.

Given a sequence of binary values, return a list of integers with the same length. Each `0` becomes `-1`. Each contiguous block of `1` values receives a block id, starting from `0` and increasing from left to right. All ones in the same contiguous block share the same id.

Accept either a string of `'0'` and `'1'` characters or an iterable containing integer `0` and `1` values. Raise `ValueError` for any other value.
